description: What you have already looked up. Lists the people you have researched, the write-ups you have had made, and the calls you have run here recently — yours only, nobody else's. Worth calling before you pay for something: if you looked this person up last month, you already have it. Use it for "have I checked this person before", "what did I look at last week", "show me what I have". Nothing is looked up and nothing is charged.
name: get_my_recent_research
